method: Same selection system as live play: random subjects and formats, then random unseen questions. Recent subjects are avoided to keep the mix varied; first 100.

questions.prompt: Name an amusement park or theme-park resort.
questions.scope: Real parks and resort complexes count worldwide; familiar resort names would be accepted.

questions.prompt: Name a cooking or food-preparation technique.
questions.scope: Recognized techniques for cooking, preparing, cutting, mixing, baking or preserving food count. Real public verb/noun forms share an answer. An ingredient, utensil, finished dish or desired texture alone is not a technique.

questions.prompt: Name an object that commonly has a hinge.
questions.scope: A common hinged version of the object must exist. Sliding or roll-up versions do not prevent a genuinely hinged object from counting.

questions.prompt: Name a type of ball used in a sport, game or athletic training.
questions.scope: Named balls used in sports, games or athletic training count, including particular game-ball designs. Pucks, shuttlecocks and punching bags are not balls.

questions.prompt: Name a named place or map from a video game.
questions.scope: Named maps, towns, regions and locations count; ordinary real-world cities need a named in-game setting.

questions.prompt: Name an animal that can produce its own light.
questions.scope: Bioluminescence, including light produced by symbiotic bacteria in an animal's light organ, counts. Reflection, fluorescence and bright coloring alone do not. Broad animal groups count when they contain documented luminous members.

questions.prompt: Name a named object in our Solar System.
questions.scope: Planets, dwarf planets, moons, named asteroids and named comets count; stars beyond the Sun do not.

questions.prompt: Name a hotel chain or hotel brand.
questions.scope: Real current or historical hotel, motel, hostel and serviced-apartment brands/chains, branded hotel collections and primarily hotel-operating groups count. Single independent properties, booking/rental marketplaces, private-equity investors and unrelated parent companies do not. Genuine short names and brand renames share an answer.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with pop music.
Name a tea brand or tea company.
questions.scope: Real current or historical tea brands, tea companies and tea estates count. A tea variety, drink preparation or generic ingredient is not a company or brand. The inventory includes packaged-tea and ready-to-drink brands; owning a separate brand does not automatically make a generic parent-name guess eligible.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has won the NBA regular-season MVP award.
questions.scope: Winners of the main NBA regular-season Most Valuable Player award through the 2025–26 season count. Finals, All-Star and other leagues' MVP awards are different.

questions.prompt: Name a fictional city or town from a movie or TV show.
questions.scope: A real place's fictional version qualifies only when it is clearly part of that story's setting.

questions.prompt: Name an online social or community platform.
questions.scope: Real current or historical general-audience social networks, social media and named online community platforms count, including group communication, public discussion networks and social virtual worlds. Ordinary email, devices, generic internet terms, individual profiles/groups, learning-management software and services dedicated to dating or adult content do not. Actual public names such as X, VK, QQ and Hi5 count; generated initials do not.

questions.prompt: Name a bone or named group of bones in the human skeleton.
questions.scope: Standard named bones, fused bones and familiar bone groups count. Left and right instances are the same answer. Cartilage, joints, muscles and organs are not bones.

questions.prompt: Name a champion in League of Legends.
questions.scope: Base-game and recorded expansion names count. Versions of the same named object count once.

questions.prompt: Name an animal that changes color.
questions.scope: Rapid camouflage and seasonal changes both count.

questions.prompt: Name a real reservoir or artificial lake.
questions.scope: Named reservoirs and artificial lakes count, including historical and seasonally dry reservoirs. A naturally formed lake does not automatically become a reservoir just because it has a regulated outlet.

questions.prompt: Name a water sport or recreational activity on or in water.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a film actor or actress.
Name a color or a named shade.
questions.scope: Recognized English color names and published named shades count, including named pigments, Crayola colors and standard CSS color keywords. Regional spellings and ordinary synonyms share one answer. Patterns are not a single color. Different standard definitions of the same ordinary name do not create extra answers.

questions.prompt: Name an ice-cream topping or mix-in.
questions.scope: Named toppings and mix-ins used on ice cream, gelato or frozen custard count, including candy, fruit, nuts, sauces and cake pieces. A flavor by itself is not a topping.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Horror”.
Name a stringed musical instrument.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a human muscle or muscle group.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has been on the San Francisco 49ers franchise roster.
questions.scope: Past or present roster membership for this franchise through the retained 2026 snapshot counts, including its earlier names/locations and NFL, AFL or AAFC membership where applicable. Offseason and practice squads count. An unrelated former team sharing the same city or code does not. The current franchise rules and captured seasons are retained for source review.

questions.prompt: Name a character from the Harry Potter books or films.
questions.scope: Identifiable characters in the Harry Potter novels, films and their epilogues count, including creatures, ghosts and portraits. Real actors are not their fictional characters. Same-name characters share one answer identity.

questions.prompt: Name a type of flower.
questions.scope: Recognized common flower types and flowering plants grown for their blooms count, including named horticultural groups and documented varieties. Materials merely named after flowers, artificial flower products and unrelated decorative objects do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a car, motorcycle, truck or bus manufacturer or brand.
questions.scope: Real current or historical manufacturers and established marques of cars, motorcycles (including racing motorcycles), trucks and buses count, including documented vehicle assembly and coachbuilding firms. A vehicle model alone, a transport operator, an aircraft/rail-only maker, a pure component supplier, a toy or a fictional brand does not count. Actual brand/company names and true renames share an answer.

questions.prompt: Name a named soup or established soup variety.
Name a type of personal protective equipment.
questions.scope: Recognized personal protective equipment and its named types count, including head, face, hearing, hand, foot, respiratory, fall, flotation and protective-clothing equipment. This classifies equipment names, not suitability for a particular hazard. Ordinary office tools, hand sanitizer and everyday clothing without a protective function do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a video game console or dedicated gaming handheld.
questions.scope: Named released game consoles, dedicated handheld game systems and purpose-built gaming handheld PCs count. Named revisions, early electronic/VHS-based gaming systems and game-library add-on platforms count; regional renames of the same platform share an answer. N-Gage is a documented gaming-handheld hybrid. General-purpose phones/computers, media-streaming boxes with optional games, unreleased prototypes and input-only controllers do not count. A self-contained plug-and-play game unit counts even if its shell resembles a controller.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played in the NBA.
Name an action movie.
Name a real DJ or DJ act, past or present.
questions.scope: Real DJs and billed DJ duos or groups count, including people known for presenting recorded music on radio. Being a singer or producer alone does not make someone a DJ. Fictional story DJs and unrelated musical groups do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of duck, goose or swan.
questions.scope: Established named groups and species in the Anatidae bird family count, including recently extinct species. Common and scientific names are accepted. Real synonyms share an identity; unrelated birds and objects named after birds do not count. Recognized domestic duck and goose breeds also count.

questions.prompt: Name a type of boat, ship or other watercraft.
questions.scope: Kinds of boat, ship, raft or other vessel designed to travel on water or underwater count, past or present. Individual named vessels, wrecks, ice-only vehicles and descriptors of condition alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a source, device or process that can generate electricity.
questions.scope: Documented energy sources, generating devices and physical conversion processes that produce electric current count, including small experimental generators and electrochemical cells. Storage devices count as conversion devices, without treating stored energy as a new primary source. Fictional devices, perpetual-motion claims, an ordinary power-consuming appliance, and a wire or transmission line alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name an item or trainer device from a Pokémon video game.
questions.scope: Named usable items and trainer devices from released Pokémon video games count, including medicine, Poké Balls, Berries, held/key items, TMs/TRs, evolution items, Pokédexes and trainer communication/navigation devices. Historical versions of the same item name share one answer. Pokémon, moves and Abilities are separate concepts.

questions.prompt: Name a type of custard or a dessert made with custard.
questions.scope: Named custards and desserts made using custard or custard powder count. A cream-only filling does not qualify merely because it is called cream.

questions.prompt: Name a mystery TV or streaming show.
Name a song by Foo Fighters.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Foo Fighters count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a driver who has competed in Formula One.
questions.scope: Drivers in the complete Jolpica/Ergast Formula One World Championship driver inventory count, including historical entrants and the Indianapolis 500 when it was part of that championship. A real surname can identify a valid driver; invented initials and racing three-letter codes do not count as names.

questions.prompt: Name a landform, natural feature or kind of landscape.
Name an insect.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a playable hero in Overwatch.
questions.scope: The full official Overwatch roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts, including heroes introduced while it was called Overwatch 2. Skins and unplayable story characters do not.

questions.prompt: Name a way to pay for something without physical cash.
questions.scope: Payment methods, payment networks and named payment services count.

questions.prompt: Name a type or form of poem.
questions.scope: Recognized named poem and verse forms count, including complete short forms and established stanza/verse forms used as poems. A subject, individual poet, book title or meter alone does not automatically name a poem form.

questions.prompt: Name a named type of bread.
questions.scope: Named breads, rolls and flatbreads count; filling-only variations do not create a new bread.

questions.prompt: Name an exercise that can be done using your bodyweight instead of added weights.
questions.scope: Named exercises and recognized variations count, including floor exercises, holds and movements on a pull-up bar. A bar or bench can provide support; dumbbells and loaded barbells are not required.

questions.prompt: Name a real astronaut or cosmonaut.
questions.scope: Professional astronauts, cosmonauts and taikonauts worldwide, past or present, count, including people selected for professional astronaut training even if they never flew. Private-company professional astronauts and payload specialists count; celebrity passengers and fictional characters are not automatically astronauts.

questions.prompt: Name a landlocked country.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a plant commonly grown as a houseplant.
questions.scope: Actual documented indoor houseplants, named groups/species/cultivars count. Do not accept every wild plant merely because it can temporarily fit in a pot.

questions.prompt: Name a tool or piece of equipment used for gardening.
questions.scope: Tools, devices and durable equipment used to plant, water, prune, move soil or maintain gardens count. Plant names are not tools.

questions.prompt: Name an item that can be used as furnace fuel in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Items actually accepted in the fuel slot count, rather than anything that merely looks flammable. Their fuel value need not be the same. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a named dish or preparation in which eggs are a main ingredient.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a fictional pirate.
questions.scope: Named fictional sea, air and space pirates count, including characters who were pirates earlier in their story. A smuggler, sailor or marine is not automatically a pirate.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete who has played professionally in a team sport.
questions.scope: Men's and women's sports, any country and any era count; no roster-year restriction.

questions.prompt: Name a musical artist or band with a number in their name.
questions.scope: Numbers written as digits, words or Roman numerals count.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of arachnid.
questions.scope: Named arachnid groups, species and recognized common kinds count. Spiders, scorpions, ticks, mites, harvestmen and other arachnid orders are included. Insects, crustaceans and myriapods are outside this question.

questions.prompt: Name a river, lake, sea, ocean, gulf, bay or strait.
Name a type of clock, watch or timekeeping device.
questions.scope: Physical timekeeping devices and recognized clock/watch types count, including historic sundials, hourglasses and water clocks. Calendar systems, units of time and software applications alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a named weapon from a video game.
questions.scope: Unique named weapons and established weapon/item names count across all platforms.

questions.prompt: Name a character from the Toy Story franchise.
questions.scope: Named or distinctly identified characters from Toy Story films, shorts, series and the Lightyear spin-off count. Established collective character identities such as the Aliens count. Voice actors, film titles and descriptive organizational headings do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a pie, tart or flan.
questions.scope: Named sweet and savory pies, tarts and flans count. Established dishes conventionally called pies count even when they use mash, crumbs or cake, including Boston cream pie and whoopie pie. An ordinary cake without a conventional pie name, pizza or an uncrusted omelette does not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with country music.
Name a kind of animal that can regrow a lost body part.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a piece of equipment used to take or process photographs.
questions.scope: Physical equipment, supplies and accessories used in still photography count, including darkroom materials. A finished photograph, filmed sequence or a device used only to mark a film take does not.

questions.prompt: Name a real named canal.
questions.scope: Named canals, shipping channels and recognized artificial waterways count worldwide, including disused historical ones. Natural rivers are not automatically canals.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Building”.
Name a type of creature from mythology, folklore, or fantasy.
Name a player who has played for the Brooklyn Nets.
questions.scope: At least one first-team NBA, BAA or ABA game for this franchise counts, past or present. Coaches, draft rights and preseason-only appearances do not. The same franchise as the New Jersey Nets, New York Nets and New York Americans counts, including ABA games.

questions.prompt: Name an appliance or powered device used in a home.
Name a song by Twenty One Pilots.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Twenty One Pilots count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a succulent plant.
questions.scope: Recognized succulent plants and documented public groups/species/cultivars count. Do not automatically include all descendants of a mixed succulent/non-succulent genus.

questions.prompt: Name a country whose national flag contains a star.
questions.scope: A visible star on the official national flag qualifies; tiny stars inside a coat of arms count too.

questions.prompt: Name a sauce, condiment, or relish served with food. Named traditional condiments count.
Name an agent in Valorant.
questions.scope: Base-game and recorded expansion names count. Versions of the same named object count once.

questions.prompt: Name a motorsport or established motor-racing series.
questions.scope: Recognized motor-vehicle competitions and racing series count, including cars, motorcycles, boats, snowmobiles and powered aircraft. Drivers, vehicle manufacturers and unpowered sports do not qualify by themselves.

questions.prompt: Name a building material.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a science fiction movie.
Name a record label or record company.
questions.scope: Real current and historical record labels, imprints and record companies count. A publisher, streaming platform or music store is not automatically a record label.

questions.prompt: Name a type of tower.
questions.scope: Types of built tower count, including towers defined by their function or structure. Individual named towers do not.

questions.prompt: Name a food that is commonly pickled.
questions.scope: Vegetables, fruits, eggs, meats and seafood with established pickled preparations count. Vinegar and brine are ingredients, not foods being pickled.

questions.prompt: Name a Pokémon type.
questions.scope: The 18 standard main-series types and the special Stellar Tera type count. The unused Bird/??? data labels and the spin-off Shadow classification are outside this explicitly main-series type list.

questions.prompt: Name a cat breed, including experimental and historical breeds.
Name a type of sports equipment.
Name an anime TV or streaming show.
Name a piece of camping equipment.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a government-issued currency, monetary unit or named historical coin.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a song with a color in its title.
questions.scope: Ordinary color words in released song titles count; color names used as surnames need context.

questions.prompt: Name a named dish commonly made with chicken.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a branch or field of mathematics.
questions.scope: Recognized mathematical branches, subfields and established mathematical research disciplines count. Both pure and applied mathematics count. Individual formulas, symbols, isolated theorems and unrelated school subjects do not by themselves name a branch.

questions.prompt: Name a block an Enderman can pick up in Minecraft.
questions.scope: The actual block-pickup rule counts, including flowers. Endermen may pick up only certain blocks even if the player can carry other blocks. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a character from SpongeBob SquarePants.
questions.scope: Named or distinctly identified characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, its films and spin-offs count. Identified character groups also count. Voice actors, episode titles and general species alone are not character names.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of animal that has a protective shell, carapace, bony plates or body armour.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has played for the Houston Rockets.
questions.scope: At least one first-team NBA, BAA or ABA game for this franchise counts, past or present. Coaches, draft rights and preseason-only appearances do not.

questions.prompt: Name a dance style, traditional dance, or named social dance.
Name a sushi style or named sushi roll.
questions.scope: Established sushi preparations, named sushi rolls and recognizable filling-specific sushi varieties count. Sashimi by itself is not sushi because it lacks the seasoned rice. A fish or ingredient alone is not a prepared sushi variety.

questions.prompt: Name a spoken, signed or constructed language.
Name a type of bottle or flask.
questions.scope: Recognizable kinds of bottle or flask count, including scientific flasks and named bottle sizes. A brand alone does not identify a bottle type.
